data.title: Hallway at the symposium
data.transcript: Speaker 1: Dan, can I ask a favour? It's Mara Quist. Speaker 2: Of course. Speaker 1: Keep this between us, but I'm starting medical leave next week; my surgery got moved up. Could you give my talk on detector cooling in the Tuesday session? Speaker 2: I'm sorry, Mara. Yes, I'll present it for you. Speaker 1: Thank you. I'll send you the slides tonight. Speaker 2: I'll let the session chair know I'm presenting in your place, without the details.

contact.name: Mara Quist
contact.context: A colleague at a symposium asked for a favour before going on leave.
